PROGRAM alarm_ctrl
VAR_INPUT
    Trip : BOOL;    // Trip / abnormal condition active
    Reset : BOOL;   // Operator reset pushbutton
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
    Alarm : BOOL;   // Latched alarm output
END_VAR
VAR
    isLatched : BOOL;
END_VAR

IF Trip THEN
    isLatched := TRUE;
ELSIF Reset AND NOT Trip THEN
    isLatched := FALSE;
END_IF

Alarm := isLatched;

END_PROGRAM

PROGRAM heater_ctrl
VAR_INPUT
    HeatRequest : BOOL; // Heat demand
    Enable : BOOL; // System enable
    OverTemp : BOOL; // Over-temperature (TRUE = too hot)
END_VAR_INPUT

VAR_OUTPUT
    Heater : BOOL; // Heater element
END_VAR_OUTPUT

BEGIN
    IF OverTemp THEN
        Heater := FALSE;
    ELSIF HeatRequest AND Enable THEN
        Heater := TRUE;
    ELSE
        Heater := FALSE;
    END_IF;
END_PROGRAM

PROGRAM elevator
VAR_INPUT
    CallUp : BOOL;
    CallDown : BOOL;
    DoorClosed : BOOL;
    AtTop : BOOL;
    AtBottom : BOOL;
END_VAR

VAR_OUTPUT
    MotorUp : BOOL := FALSE;
    MotorDown : BOOL := FALSE;
END_VAR

VAR
    State : INT := 0; // 0=At-bottom, 1=Moving-up, 2=At-top, 3=Moving-down
END_VAR

BEGIN
    MotorUp := FALSE;
    MotorDown := FALSE;
    
    IF NOT DoorClosed THEN
        // Ensure motors are not active if the door is open
        RETURN;
    END_IF

    CASE State OF
        0: // At-bottom
            IF CallUp AND NOT AtTop THEN
                State := 1; // Transition to Moving-up
            END_IF

        1: // Moving-up
            IF AtTop THEN
                State := 2; // Transition to At-top
            ELSE
                MotorUp := TRUE; // Drive up
            END_IF

        2: // At-top
            IF CallDown AND NOT AtBottom THEN
                State := 3; // Transition to Moving-down
            END_IF

        3: // Moving-down
            IF AtBottom THEN
                State := 0; // Transition to At-bottom
            ELSE
                MotorDown := TRUE; // Drive down
            END_IF
    END_CASE
END_PROGRAM

PROGRAM two_hand
VAR_INPUT
    LH : BOOL; (* Left-hand button *)
    RH : BOOL; (* Right-hand button *)
END_VAR_INPUT

VAR_OUTPUT
    Actuator : BOOL; (* Press actuator *)
END_VAR_OUTPUT

VAR
    Armed : BOOL; (* Anti-tie-down armed flag *)
END_VAR

(* Arm the control when both buttons are released *)
IF NOT LH AND NOT RH THEN
    Armed := TRUE;
ELSIF LH XOR RH THEN
    Armed := FALSE;
END_IF

(* Control the actuator *)
IF Armed AND LH AND RH THEN
    Actuator := TRUE;
ELSE
    Actuator := FALSE;
END_IF

END_PROGRAM
